tagline.en: Software systems built around real business needs.
tagline.ar: أنظمة برمجية مبنية حول احتياجات الأعمال الحقيقية.

description.en: HexaTerminal is a software development company that builds custom ERP and CRM systems, web platforms, mobile applications, e-commerce solutions, and business websites.
description.ar: HexaTerminal شركة برمجيات تبني أنظمة ERP وCRM مخصصة، ومنصات ويب، وتطبيقات جوال، وحلول تجارة إلكترونية، ومواقع أعمال.

footer_note.en: Custom software, platforms, and digital systems for growing businesses.
footer_note.ar: برمجيات مخصصة ومنصات وأنظمة رقمية للأعمال النامية.

assumptions.note: Use the official email as the initial lead recipient unless the existing project already has a deliberate production-safe configuration that differs.

rules: Do not invent missing company facts.
Do not add fake address, social profiles, booking links, analytics identifiers, or marketing claims.
Use the existing Spatie translatable structure for translated fields.
Use the existing single-row CompanySetting architecture.
Do not redesign the CMS or add fields in this task.
Keep the fresh seed reproducible from the repository.
